card.name: Linking words inside procedure and mission descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (commas, "will", "is", "that", "from", "and") right after the subject of a sentence describing a technical procedure or mission. The subject is a spacecraft, a needle, a fluid or a scan, and the verb phrase is about to follow.

modes.label: Spacecraft and missions
modes.description: A linking word after a spacecraft, rover or launch vehicle subject in a space mission narrative.

modes.label: Medical test procedures
modes.description: A linking word after the subject in a description of how a test or procedure is done.
modes.example: A needle<< is>> put through your skin into your uterus.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are word endings and code-like pieces, with no clear effect on the output.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come after the thing being described in a how-it-works passage about a scan, test or space mission.
